Golden dawn and fine spray, distant sages in clouds. Varaha is animal-bodied in this textual scene, no human torso or arms, no weapons, no extra limbs, no cartoon, no gore, no text. Refined hand-painted pigments, muted ivory and antique gold, epic but calm, anatomically coherent and clear.
